topic: 定语从句（关系代词与关系副词的选择与运用）
teaching_notes: 同学们好！今天我们来学习给句子做“贴纸”的定语从句。关系代词和副词就像魔法胶水：指人时用 who，指物时用 which，人或物通用可以用 that；如果表示“谁的（所属关系）”，记得要用 whose；而表示“在某个地点”且从句句子完整时，则用 where。只要看清前面的名词（先行词）并分析从句缺什么成分，就能轻松选对魔法胶水啦！例如：The teacher who wears a yellow hat is nice. / This is the park where we played yesterday.

questions.question: The girl _______ is singing on the stage is my best friend.
questions.explanation: 先行词是 The girl（人），且在定语从句中作主语，因此用关系代词 who。

questions.question: This is the magical book _______ has many fascinating fairy tales.
questions.explanation: 先行词是 book（物），在从句中作主语，因此使用关系代词 which。

questions.question: Look at the cute puppy _______ tail is very short!
questions.explanation: 空格后是名词 tail，这里表示“小狗的尾巴”，表示所属关系（……的），因此用 whose。

questions.question: Do you still remember the museum _______ we visited last summer?
questions.explanation: 先行词是 museum（物），从句中动词 visited 缺少宾语，因此用关系代词 that 或 which。

questions.question: I really love the quiet village _______ my grandparents live.
questions.explanation: 先行词是 village（地点），在从句中作地点状语（ live 在此处为不及物动词），因此用关系副词 where。

questions.question: The boy _______ bicycle was stolen yesterday reported it to the police.
questions.explanation: 空格后是名词 bicycle，表示“男孩的自行车”，表所属关系，故填 whose。

questions.question: Halloween is a mysterious evening _______ children dress up in funny costumes.
questions.explanation: 先行词是 evening（时间），从句成分完整，因此用关系副词 when 来指代时间。

questions.question: The science teacher _______ taught us electricity last year has won an award.
questions.explanation: 先行词是 teacher（人），在从句中作主语，关系代词可用 who 或 that。

questions.question: A pumpkin lantern is a carved vegetable _______ glows brightly in the dark.
questions.explanation: 先行词是 vegetable（物），在从句中作主语，故用 which。

questions.question: The castle _______ the king lived fifty years ago is now open to visitors.
questions.explanation: 先行词是 castle（地点），从句句子完整（lived 在此处为不及物动词），表示“国王居住的地方”，故用 where。

questions.question: I met an international student _______ mother language is French.
questions.explanation: 表示“这位留学生的母语”，作定语表所属关系，选 whose。

questions.question: Is there anyone _______ can answer this difficult math question?
questions.explanation: 当先行词为不定代词 anyone, someone, nobody 等时，关系代词优先使用 that（指人）。

questions.question: The delicious pizza _______ my mom made for dinner was eaten in five minutes.
questions.explanation: 先行词是 pizza（物），在从句中作 made 的宾语，故用 which。

questions.question: That is the cozy playground _______ we usually play football after school.
questions.explanation: 先行词是 playground（地点），从句 we play football 完整，表示“在游乐场”，故用 where。

questions.question: The painter _______ artwork was displayed in the gallery is very famous.
questions.explanation: 表示“画家的艺术作品”，即所属关系，用 whose。

questions.question: The robot _______ was invented by the high school student can fold clothes.
questions.explanation: 先行词为 robot（物），在从句中作主语，可选用 that 或 which。

questions.question: The doctor _______ examined my leg was gentle and patient.
questions.explanation: 先行词是 doctor（人），在从句中作主语，用 relationship pronoun who。

questions.question: This is the hospital _______ my aunt works as a senior nurse.
questions.explanation: 先行词是 hospital（地点），从句 my aunt works（作不及物动词）成分完整，故用关系副词 where。

questions.question: The computer _______ display screen is broken needs to be repaired immediately.
questions.explanation: whose 也可以用于指“无生命物体的……的”。这里指电脑的显示屏（the computer's display screen），故选 whose。

questions.question: The autumn leaves _______ fell from the big oak tree covered the lawn.
questions.explanation: 先行词是 autumn leaves（物），在从句中作主语，故用 which。

questions.question: I will never forget the day _______ our team won the school basketball championship.
questions.explanation: 先行词是 the day（时间），在从句中充当时间状语，故用关系副词 when。

questions.question: The detective _______ solved the mystery case received a medal yesterday.
questions.explanation: 先行词是 detective（人），作从句主语，用 who。

questions.question: Please show me the photo _______ you took during your visit to Paris.
questions.explanation: 先行词是 photo（物），在从句中作 took 的宾语，故用 that 或 which。

questions.question: The laboratory _______ the scientists conduct their experiments is clean and bright.
questions.explanation: 先行词是 laboratory（地点），从句成分完整，表示“在实验室里”，故用关系副词 where。

questions.question: The writer _______ stories are popular among teenagers will give a talk tomorrow.
questions.explanation: 先行词是 writer（人），后接名词 stories，表示“这位作者的故事”，用 whose。

questions.question: All the snacks _______ were served at the Halloween party were tasty.
questions.explanation: 当先行词被 All 修饰或先行词本身包含 all 时，关系代词优先使用 that。

questions.question: The athlete _______ runner-up trophy was stolen felt very upset.
questions.explanation: 表示“运动员的亚军奖杯”，属于所属关系，故用 whose。

questions.question: The warm sweater _______ grandma knitted for me keeps me warm in winter.
questions.explanation: 先行词是 sweater（物），在从句中作 knitted 的宾语，故用 which。

questions.question: This is the library section _______ you can find books about space exploration.
questions.explanation: 先行词是 library section（区域/地点），从句为完整主谓宾结构，表示“在该区域中”，故用 where。

questions.question: Students _______ complete all their homework on time will earn reward stars.
questions.explanation: 先行词是 Students（人），在从句中作主语，故使用关系代词 who。
